name: open-design-design-system-from-url
description: Make a design system from a website, a Figma file or a Canva design — measure its real colours, fonts, spacing and button states, write DESIGN.md and tokens.css that agree, and check the result side by side with the source before saving — use whenever the user wants a design system, brand kit, theme or tokens taken from a website, URL, Figma file or Canva design ("make a design system from stripe.com", "take our design system from my Figma file", "use my Canva brand", "match our site's look", "extract the brand from this page"), even if they don't mention Open Design
